component_scope: offline prompt, exact coverage/count gate and whole-prefix grammar only
adaptations_from_v1: JSON-only unambiguous prompt with no fenced example or placeholder keys
exact ordered input keys and exactly eight distinct alternatives or explicit empty abstention
irreversibly invalid whole-JSON prefix stops after the current committed token
strict source identity/count/duplicate checks; no semantic certification

cohort.selection: unchanged first2chunks of first fixed baseline cover

response_schema.root: one object with only words field
response_schema.rows: exactly one ordered singleton object per source word
response_schema.values: [] abstention or exactly8 nonempty unpadded strings
response_schema.uniqueness: casefold after collapsing whitespace, excluding source surface
response_schema.unicode_rule_scope: Conservative surface-format restriction for this English cohort; not a general multilingual linguistic rule

context_limitation: Five tokens can underdetermine sense, reference and morphology; instruction compliance is not semantic proof.

proposed_native_settings.profile_scope: resources/runtime/READY/resident identities only; inherited temperature0.8 is not proposed sampler
proposed_native_settings.reset: fresh owned native process per attempt
proposed_native_settings.EOS_policy: same existing EOS/special mask; not vanilla EOS-terminated generation
proposed_native_settings.seed_policy: HMAC/draw implementation must be separately frozen under new native ID, bound to requestSHA and fixed attempt0..2; no seed search

prefix_policy.input: exact bytes of entire committed response, not a sliced convenience file
prefix_policy.complete: entire object plus only JSON whitespace; run strict response gate and stop
prefix_policy.invalid_prefix: stop and record known format refusal; no scanning, fence stripping, repair or token truncation
prefix_policy.incomplete: continue until complete/invalid/resource refusal or committed512token cap
prefix_policy.partial_UTF8: wait conservatively without lossy decoding; invalid UTF8 is refused
prefix_policy.resource_refusal: known parser-limit refusal; stop campaign without automatic retry
prefix_policy.known_refusal_next_attempt: only next predeclared attempt, maximum3, with complete verified journal
prefix_policy.unknown_incomplete_journal_or_transport_: stop campaign; no retry or resume

journal_gate.required_before_format_acceptance: verify_bundle on the persisted sealed attempt; trusted terminal commitment and resource/request/protocol bindings; use verified response bytes
journal_gate.post_save_check: independent exact Git readback and sealed-bundle verification; later tampering/truncation must be recorded, never filled in

next_native_requires: new integrated native runner and source closure
native activation and immutable execution intent
full_cover_policy: All109 ordered chunks must be accounted for, including abstentions/refusals/unattempted. No original/fixed matched transport from a two-chunk diagnostic.
all50_workload_scope: metadata-only counts from pinned first50 records; not native authorization or a runtime prediction
